suppressedMessages.message: React Hook useEffect has missing dependencies: 'content.livePreviewEnabled', 'draftContent.page', 'draftContent.pageSpecificData', and 'locale'. Either include them or remove the dependency array.

suggestions.desc: Update the dependencies array to be: [content.livePreviewEnabled, contentTypeUid, draftContent.page, draftContent.pageSpecificData, locale]
